ratings_why.fun: Hold-or-cast with Steep, lens units and counting the Recipe give real decisions every turn, and the growth curve starts small and ends huge, which is a climb I'd happily draft.
ratings_why.distinct: Growing spells and a spell counter echo Battlegrounds' Naga, but Steeping in hand, merging Phials and aiming at lenses for Echoes are fresh.

verdict_why: The core works, but The Old Lady's count with The Alchymist needs a ruling and the Tier 1-2 Phial cards are thin before Show-Globe Keeper arrives.

points.text: The Alchymist's Echoes add to the Recipe, but Echoes trigger nothing. Say whether an Echo that lands the Recipe on a multiple of 5 fires The Old Lady.

Dame Pavonia multiplies by (1 + N/10) on every cast, and Old Carbonaria's N rises with the Recipe, so she grows exponentially late. Test the designer's own cap (scale on start-of-turn stats) before the owner balances.
At Tier 2 you hold one or two small Phials, so Pestle Grinder adds only a few stats. Making it also give a Phial 1 would let it seed the hand as well as ripen it.
Lamp-Circler counts Phials, but early on you hold zero or one, so it's a plain 2/3. Counting total N instead would reward holding and match Burnet.
Bought units also go to the 4-slot hand, so Big Batch's full hand blocks buying. Show what happens on a buy with a full hand, maybe letting Cocoon Spinner fold a Phial in to make room.

standouts.why: Turns a weak cast on a small lens into two scaled Echoes on the big back row, so positioning matters while recruiting.
Overflow merging past the Steep cap gives the hold build its own goal and feeds Elder and Burnet.
Big casts leave a half-Phial behind, which links the many-casts and few-big-casts plans neatly.

weakest.why: A one-off Steep when you hold almost no Phials is a small, forgettable turn.
Counts Phials at the stage of the game you have fewest; plays as a vanilla 2/3.
A random +1/+1 per spell last turn is generic and low next to the rest of Tier 3.

flags.note: Each cast on a lens multiplies her stats; with three to five casts a turn she can grow ×2-3 a turn late.
Recipe feeds N, The Alchymist's Echoes feed the Recipe, and a bigger N scales harder on big units: a loop that speeds up, though it adds only one Phial a turn.
With Cocoon Spinner the merged Phial has no cap and you can hold it forever, so Burnet's damage keeps climbing.
Unclear whether The Alchymist's counted Echoes can bring the Recipe to a multiple of 5 and fire this.
